summary: C29 separates local web liveness from real readiness. GET /healthz is now a liveness-only web-shell response, while GET /readyz probes web assets, the loopback engine /healthz, the configured authoritative storage surface and each enabled provider with fixed typed failure codes, returning 200 ready, 200 degraded for optional-only failure and 503 not_ready for a required failure. GET /api/diagnostics always returns 200 with the component list, the bounded redacted log ring, limits and a timestamp. Logs are written on transitions only (required error, optional warn, recovery info), are capped at 32 entries / 8192 bytes / 256 message characters, redact Authorization, Cookie, token, secret, password, api_key and Bearer values, and reset on restart. The supervisor marks storage and provider surfaces required only when it enables them, and serve-web rejects unknown storage surfaces and unsupported providers instead of faking readiness. /healthz is no longer used as an engine-readiness signal: the launcher, clone smoke and benchmark now wait on /readyz. Verification on the documented toolchain: a real Go engine with the C05-backed sensor store reached ready twice across a restart with empty logs, unreachable and malformed engines and failing required/optional providers produced the declared codes and statuses, sentinel headers/bodies never reached diagnostics, 40 readiness transitions were bounded, missing index.html made web not ready, and 40 malformed workload/fixture mutations were rejected. 6 readiness tests, 94 Node tests, 195 engine anchors (222 top-level / 353 subtest passes), 6 Python tests, repository contracts and the real clean-clone smoke passed. No commit, push, hosted Actions, browser run or C30/C40 claim.
hosted_actions_note: Not run for this source. No push or publication occurred; remote workflow status is unverified.
scope_limits: Local Linux single-operator profile only; readiness covers the web shell, the loopback Go engine, the enabled storage surface and the enabled certificate/update providers.
Rootless Podman and the isolated decoy are engine CLI surfaces, not web-supervised components; declaring podman as a readiness provider is rejected instead of reported ready.
Diagnostics are per web-server instance and deliberately reset on restart; they are not durable audit records.

The source identity covers the implementation tree before the progress, handoff and generated-project bookkeeping edits; no commit was created, so the final working tree identity differs from the recorded one.
No browser run, hosted Actions, deployment, release, C30 clean-host workflow or C40 artifact claim.

local_environment.notes: The machine's go env sets GOSUMDB=off, so engine-spawning Node tests require the documented GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.2 environment. Podman was not exercised by C29.
